oracle_policy: Every case maps to exactly one fixed outcome in the pinned planner packet; assertions are specified independently of candidate output.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Query a newly owned graph before any SOP or incident fixture is seeded.
cases.setup: Create one unique owned graph and leave it cold/empty.
pinned_assertions: zero impact paths
zero SOP versions
zero role claims
zero source rows
no exposed counts or invented no-conflict conclusion; state is empty/unknown
cases.failure_detected: Phantom fixture defaults, count/existence leakage, or empty graph falsely presented as proof of no conflict.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: At the pinned observed outage instant, require exact path order and existing source provenance.
cases.setup: Use actual FalkorDB with the synthetic INC-204/C4 graph at 2026-10-14T18:30:00Z.
pinned_assertions: exact ordered INC-204 -> C4 -> service -> central-sterile -> ROLE-STERILE-OPS-COORD path
exact ordered INC-204 -> C4 -> service -> materials-logistics -> ROLE-MATERIALS-DUTY path
path source IDs and titles equal the unchanged original oracle
all per-path observed_at values equal the unchanged original oracle
current ownership provenance is unchanged
cases.failure_detected: A text/property join, reordered/extra path, or provenance/timestamp drift from the original oracle.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Demand the explicit two-version unresolved conflict, applicability edges, typed claims, and source evidence.
cases.setup: Join both C4 APPLIES_TO edges and the V2-to-V3 SOP_CONFLICT edge to each typed CLAIMS_ROLE link and its explicitly linked source-evidence record.
pinned_assertions: V2 APPLIES_TO CONVEYOR-C4 and V3 APPLIES_TO CONVEYOR-C4
V2 SOP_CONFLICT V3 has status unresolved
V2 CLAIMS_ROLE is ROLE-FACILITIES-DUTY and V3 CLAIMS_ROLE is ROLE-MATERIALS-LEAD
both labels are exactly unverified SOP claim, not current owner
V2 source ID/title/time are SRC-SOP-CURRENT-V2 / Synthetic SOP-OPS-9 Current Text v2 / 2026-10-14T16:00:00Z
V3 source ID/title/time are SRC-SOP-CURRENT-V3 / Synthetic SOP-OPS-9 Current Text v3 / 2026-10-14T16:04:00Z
exactly two claims are returned
conflict remains unresolved
neither claim is selected as winner
cases.failure_detected: Unproven property-only association, dropped provenance, role claim presented as ownership, or fabricated conflict resolution.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Ensure archived SOP-OPS-9 V1 remains visible without joining its retired C3 reference to C4.
cases.setup: Seed the operations-visible V1/archive source and the current C4 conflict witness.
pinned_assertions: stale ID is SOP-OPS-9-V1 and source is SRC-SOP-ARCHIVE-9
archive title and observed time are exact
V1 references CONVEYOR-C3
V1 is not hidden
V1 is not a C4/INC-204 conflict witness
cases.failure_detected: Stale C3 reference silently treated as current C4 applicability, or visible history concealed.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Remove only the owned V2 APPLIES_TO C4 edge.
cases.setup: Capture baseline paths/witness; remove the test-owned V2-to-C4 APPLIES_TO relation only; query again.
pinned_assertions: the removed relation is V2 APPLIES_TO C4
complete V2/V3 conflict witness disappears
impact linkage is incomplete/unknown rather than resolved/absent
both exact outage paths remain
outage paths are unchanged
cases.failure_detected: Static/precomputed conflict-to-impact mapping, broad mutation, lost outage paths, or unknown evidence rendered as resolution/absence.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Remove only the explicit V2-to-V3 SOP_CONFLICT edge and then reseed it.
cases.setup: Remove the test-owned V2 SOP_CONFLICT V3 relation; verify claims and outage paths; reseed and compare the exact baseline witness.
pinned_assertions: only V2 SOP_CONFLICT V3 is removed
complete linked witness disappears
missing conflict linkage reports unknown, never no-conflict or resolved
source-backed role claims remain
both exact outage paths remain unchanged
reseed restores exact pinned conflict witness
conflict edge status before removal is unresolved
cases.failure_detected: Query ignores graph edge removal, source facts are deleted with an edge, outage paths change, or reseed changes the witness.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Query after the observed C4 restoration while retaining the SOP source records.
cases.setup: Query the unchanged actual graph at 2026-10-14T19:30:00Z.
pinned_assertions: active impact path list is empty
SOP-OPS-9 conflict remains source-backed and unresolved
conflict is separate from outage event state
no SOP-safe conclusion is inferred
no no-operational-risk conclusion is inferred
cases.failure_detected: Restoration incorrectly removes/resolves SOP disagreement or is misrepresented as proof of safety/no risk.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Inject the fixed distinctive restricted SOP/role claim/evidence/path probe.
cases.setup: Capture operations response, add only fixture.restricted_probe nodes/relations with restricted ACL, then compare the semantic response and scan every probe literal.
pinned_assertions: viewer scope is operations and probe ACL is restricted
operations result is semantically identical before/after
no hidden ID/title/text is disclosed
no hidden count or existence is disclosed
no hidden relation/path is disclosed
no dependent paraphrase is disclosed
cases.failure_detected: Direct, count/existence, relationship, path, or derived-language disclosure from denied evidence.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Repeat deterministic seeding, remove/reseed an owned relation, and compare a fresh client snapshot.
cases.setup: Use one unique lane-owned FalkorDB graph; seed twice, remove/reseed only a test-owned relationship, reconnect with a new client, and clean up only the graph/process started by this check.
pinned_assertions: second seed creates zero nodes
second seed creates zero relationships
test-owned relation reseed restores exact ordered outage paths
reseed restores exact role claims, source IDs/titles, and timestamps
new FalkorDB client returns the complete same semantic snapshot
graph name is unique/lane-owned and cleanup removes only owned graph/process
cases.failure_detected: Non-idempotent fixture, incomplete restoration, warm-client cache dependency, cross-lane graph collision, or cleanup of another resource.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Normalize an explicit offset, reject malformed time, compare desktop/mobile and verify the local-only boundary.
cases.setup: Query 2026-10-14T20:30:00+02:00; submit not-a-timestamp to pre-write validation; compare API/browser semantics at desktop and mobile; inspect action/network effects.
pinned_assertions: offset input is exactly 2026-10-14T20:30:00+02:00
normalizes to 2026-10-14T18:30:00Z and the exact two outage paths
not-a-timestamp is rejected before graph mutation
desktop/mobile API and browser results agree semantically
no clinical inference, chosen procedure, or person assignment
no message, call, ticket, external write, or automatic confirmation
cases.failure_detected: Timezone confusion, partial write on malformed time, responsive view disagreement, clinical/operational action invention, or external side effect.
